messages:
toni (Design): new mock for Compliance > Encryption region selector. goal: clearly indicate Redwood-managed vs customer KMS (BYOK). screenshot attached :camera:  looking for copy, a11y, and keyboard notes.

mohit (Product): nice. two quick product asks: 1) preselect account default region but allow override, 2) expand BYOK inline to 'bring your own key' in helper text so non-technical users get it.

kevin (Eng): implementation constraints: custom combobox for modern clients, native <select> fallback for older UAs. must follow ARIA combobox pattern: aria-activedescendant on options, aria-describedby referencing helper copy, and a polite aria-live status announcing changes. example aria-live text: "Region set to eu-west-1. Using customer-managed key; audit logs will record key reference."

samir (Security): copy nit: avoid vague label "Encrypted". use explicit labels: "Redwood-managed key (AES-256)" and "Customer-managed KMS (BYOK)". replace any "key id" language with "key reference". helper text should state: "Audit logs record region and key reference when customer-managed keys are used."

a11y-bot: automated checklist: combobox pattern present; aria-activedescendant updates with keyboard nav; aria-describedby references helper text; focus outline visible on keyboard; badge text contrast >= 4.5:1. flagged items need manual review. :white_check_mark:

toni (Design): thanks. I'll update the mock and push: new badge labels (shield/key icons), helper text tied via aria-describedby, disabled BYOK tooltip copy ("Requires uploaded key + IAM role 12 see docs"), and modal copy for switching to BYOK with a propagation note. will post updated image and small a11y checklist in the ticket later today.
